messages.text: I did but I’m trying to pool
I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Let me pull the exact Harlo pool settings so we're not guessing.
Read heliumdeploy.com/pages/harlo-pool
Searched the web · Harlo pool stratum URL port Harlo Labs

Got it. Let's fix the pool side on the Bitaxe itself.

One question so I point you at the right thing: in the Bitaxe dashboard right now, what does it show under the pool section? Specifically:

1. The stratum URL and port you typed in
2. Whether "Shares accepted" is counting up or stuck at 0

If it is stuck at 0, it is almost always one of three things: port typed with the `stratum+tcp://` prefix still in the URL field, the worker field not being a plain BTC address, or the unit sitting on a network that blocks the pool port.

Send me those two lines (a screenshot of the dashboard is perfect) and I'll tell you which one it is.
im trying to use Harlo Pool
Understood. Let me pull the Harlo Pool connection details from our page so I give you the exact strings.
Searched the web · heliumdeploy Harlo Pool connect your miner stratum
Checking our Harlo OS page for the pool connection strings, one moment.
Read heliumdeploy.com/pages/harlo-os
Read heliumdeploy.com/pages/harlo-pool

Thanks, that changes one thing I told you earlier, so let me correct it.

Harlo Pool is a 
0% fee Bitcoin Cash pool
, not a Bitcoin one. So the settings are:

1. Pool URL: `stratum+tcp://pool.harlolabs.com:8888`
2. Worker: 
your BCH address
 (not your BTC address, that is what I got wrong above)
3. Password: `x`

Your Bitaxe Gamma 602 will happily hash on that and the 
rewards go straight to the wallet address you put in the worker field
.

The one catch: the free spins are tied to the firmware. 
Harlo OS is what the free spins need
, and 
the requirement is one Harlo OS miner holding 800 GH/s for a full hour, with a gap over 5 minutes restarting the hour
. The published support list has Bitaxe Gamma 601 and Naja Duo, not the 602, so your unit can mine on the pool but will not earn spins today.

Want me to check the live list at harlolabs.com to see whether a Gamma 602 profile has landed since?
Yes please and when will harlolabs allow the 602
I'm checking the live model list at harlolabs.com now.
Read harlolabs.com

I could not open harlolabs.com from here, so I will not pretend to read the live list. What I can tell you for certain is what our own Harlo OS page lists today: 17 models, with Bitaxe Gamma 601 and Bitaxe Naja Duo on it, and no Gamma 602 entry.

On when the 602 lands: I do not know, and I will not guess a date. JD is the single developer who builds Harlo OS and he ships most weeks, and new models get announced in the Discord before they land, so that is where the real answer lives.

Two things I am doing:

1. Passing your question to JD so the 602 request is logged with him.
2. Pointing you at the fastest route: the Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , ask @nullhashrate directly about a Bitaxe Gamma 602 profile. He answers there quickly.

In the meantime your 602 can mine on Harlo Pool right now with the three settings above, just without the spins.
Handed to the team · Cannot read harlolabs.com from this session to confirm the live model list, and
The team has it, and someone can jump into this chat shortly. If you step away, you will get the answer by email.
Yes

Great, stay in the chat and JD's answer on the 602 will land here.

While we wait, want me to walk you through pointing the 602 at Harlo Pool so it is already hashing? It is three fields in the Bitaxe dashboard:

1. Stratum URL: `pool.harlolabs.com`, port `8888`
2. Worker: your BCH address
3. Password: `x`

Then save and restart. Tell me when you have saved it and I will tell you what "connected and accepting" should look like on the dashboard.
I’m already on the pool but I want to be able to log in

That part is separate from the mining, and you do not need Harlo OS for it.

1. Go to https://pool.harlolabs.com
2. Log in with your email (the account is created on the pool site itself, nothing to do with your HeliumDeploy account)
3. Once in, link your BCH wallet address, the same one you put in the worker field on the miner

That is what ties the hashing your 602 is already doing to an account you can see. The spin counter is the only part gated behind Harlo OS plus 800 GH/s held for a full hour.

What happens when you try to log in: does it reject the email, never send the link, or something else on screen? Tell me what you see and I will take the next step from there.
I’m about to log in to pool but I want to get access to Harlo Labs

Good news: Harlo Labs has nothing to log into. There is no account and no app.

harlolabs.com is just the flasher. You open it in Chrome or Edge, pick your model, plug the miner in with a USB data cable, erase and install, power it back up. About two minutes, free, no sign up.

The two places where "access" means something:

1. The pool account at pool.harlolabs.com, which is the email login you are about to do. That is where spins, Bolts and your linked BCH wallet live.
2. The Harlo Labs Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , which is the community and where JD (@nullhashrate) posts every build. That is where your Gamma 602 question gets answered fastest.

So: no third login exists. Which of those two were you after?
So there is a way with my Bitaxe Gamma 602 to download the firmware for Harlo Labs

Straight answer: not today, not officially.

The flasher at harlolabs.com is free and open to anyone, no account needed, so you can open it right now. But it only installs the hardware profile for the model you pick, and the published list has Bitaxe Gamma 601 and Bitaxe Naja Duo, no Gamma 602.

What I would not do is pick the 601 profile and hope. A mismatched profile sets the wrong chip voltage and frequency defaults for your board, and that is how people cook a Bitaxe. Not worth it for a spin counter.

Two things that are worth doing:

1. Open harlolabs.com in Chrome or Edge and look at the model dropdown yourself. I cannot reach that site from here, and JD adds models most weeks, so the list in front of you is newer than mine. If "Bitaxe Gamma 602" is in there, you are good to flash.
2. If it is not there, ask @nullhashrate in https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf for a 602 profile. Your question is already with him from earlier, and that is where he answers fastest.

Either way your 602 keeps mining on Harlo Pool on its stock firmware. Can you take a look at that dropdown and tell me what you see?
Sent him

Perfect, that is the right move. JD is active there and your question is also logged with him from this chat, so it is in front of him twice.

While you wait, your 602 can stay on Harlo Pool on its stock firmware: `pool.harlolabs.com` port `8888`, your BCH address as the worker, `x` as the password.

If anything on the pool login or the miner's pool stats looks off once you are in, come back here and I will work through it with you.
Sent him a message he has not responded

That is normal, it has only been a few minutes and he is one developer. I cannot promise when he replies, and I will not invent a time for you.

One thing that usually helps: if you sent him a direct message, post the same question in the public Harlo OS channel in the server instead of a DM. DMs get buried, the public channel gets seen by JD and by owners who already run Gamma hardware, and someone there may know straight away whether a 602 profile exists in a recent build.

Worth including in the post: "Bitaxe Gamma 602, is there a Harlo OS profile for it or planned?" That is the whole question and it tends to get a fast yes or no.

Your request is also sitting with our team from this chat, so it is tracked on our side too.
